'''Patrizia''' is a male fishermen NPC found at Helm Village in [[Riccioli Islands]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}


==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Patrizia''': Fresh octopus clams! Just pulled from the water!
:'''Patrizia''': Care for a taste, hungry traveler?
:{{DIcon}} Octopus clams?
:'''Patrizia''': Absolutely fresh! Look at this one's siphons, still glistening with seawater!
:'''Patrizia''': Just pop them open with a knife, squeeze on some lemon, and you're all set!
:{{DIcon}} Eat them raw!?
:'''Patrizia''': Oh, they're delicious, you've got to try them!
:'''Patrizia''': If you're interested in buying, I've got the freshest stock around, no doubt about it.
{{Dialogue End}}
